clips.title: The story
paras: The Terrowulf worgen howl through Howling Vale in north-central Ashenvale, near the Felwood border. Their caves hide an ancient shrine to Elune, bound to the worgen’s origins on Kalimdor.

North of the road to Felwood, Ashenvale’s calm gives way to the howls of the Terrowulf. Ancient trees still fill the vale, but corrupted packlords and aggressive wildlife roam among them. A cave at its heart holds the shrine of Mel'Thandris, an ancient night elf priestess. Once a place of quiet devotion, the shrine now lies in ruins, defiled by feral wolf-men whose origin puzzles the nearby Sentinels.
